mainEntity.name: What should homeowners prepare before planning an in-law suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before scheduling a design consultation, gather key details about your property and your family's intended use. Consider who will live in the space, whether they need immediate accessibility accommodations such as step-free entries or walk-in showers, and if they require separate kitchen facilities. Locate any existing property surveys to identify property lines and available yard area. It is also helpful to identify the location of your main electrical panel, water heater, and main sewer line, as their capacity and physical distance directly affect the project scope and plumbing layout. Having these details ready streamlines the initial planning conversation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather property surveys, clarify accessibility needs, decide on kitchen or laundry requirements, and note the locations of your electrical panel and main plumbing lines.
